title: Aromatic Jamaican Chicken Skewers
description: A citrusy and snappy Jamaican dish featuring chicken skewers, perfect for a light and refreshing meal. This flexitarian-friendly recipe uses high heat cooking oil to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, grated ginger, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
Reduce the marinade by cooking it in a saucepan over medium heat until thickened, about 5 minutes, and serve alongside the skewers.
